notes.title: Happy 2018, game updated with grammar and spelling fixes
notes.notes:
Hope everyone had a great new years eve.

Thanks to a dear friend and fan of the game, it has been checked for spelling and gramatical errors. This new update is out for the PC versions of the game, the Mac variant to follow soon.

Time to get back to developing the sequel ;)
Let's make this a wonderful 2018.
